text:
alex: Heads up — saw a spike of failing GPU node boot attempts in prod since 09:12 UTC. New nodes can't finish bootstrap: `keystore decrypt` calls are 403/AccessDenied from KMS and audit-shipper is being rate-limited by NATGW.

mira: yup alerted at 09:15. Cluster-autoscaler kicked, but nodes stall at `node-init` step. Sample error from node logs: `ERROR: KMS AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized to UseKey`. Also seeing `connection reset` to keystore-proxy IPs.

sam: I traced it — yesterday's firewall hardening rolled a default egress deny on the onboarding subnets (policy id fw-harden-2026-03). It blocked the ephemeral keystore IPs we use for node bootstrap. That explains both KMS 403s (because keystore proxy couldn't reach KMS) and the NATGW QPS spikes as retries pile up.

priya: expanding egress opens compliance flags for EMEA customers. We can't just whitelabel 0.0.0.0/0. Need a scoped workaround.

kevin: short-term option: add a targeted allowlist for the keystore-proxy static egress IPs and the KMS endpoint range, only for the ASG used by GPU warm pools. Then remove once we have a better policy.

mira: agreed. proposed plan: 1) add allowlist for `keystore-proxy-1` and `keystore-proxy-2` IPs for tag `asg:gpu-warmpool` only; 2) restart node-init daemons for stuck nodes; 3) monitor `node_join_success` and KMS error rate for 30m; 4) postmortem.

sam: commands to validate from a bastion in the affected subnet: ```bash
# test keystore proxy reachability
curl -v --resolve keystore.internal:443:10.12.34.56 https://keystore.internal/health
# attempt a decrypt (dry-run)
kubectl exec -n infra pod/keystore-test -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS https://keystore.internal/decrypt | jq ."
```

alex: good. ops checklist: annotate the firewall rollout ticket with the temporary exception window and exact IPs. Priya — can your team sign off on an exception window (30–90 minutes) for onboarding ASG?

priya: I can sign off for 30 minutes if we scope to `asg:gpu-warmpool` and the three service principals involved. Need JIRA ticket and audit entry.

deploy-bot: FW_RULE_UPDATE applied by sam at 09:28 UTC -> rule fw-exception-gpu-warmpool (egress allow to 10.12.34.56,10.12.34.57 for tag `asg:gpu-warmpool`).

mira: restarted `node-init` on 12 pending hosts at 09:33. 9 of 12 progressed to `kubelet` stage within 3m. KMS error rate dropped from 48/min to 2/min. NATGW QPS normalized.

alex: excellent. follow-ups: (a) run a targeted canary where we harden other subnets to the new deny and confirm only the onboarding ASG is exempt; (b) create long-term config: use private endpoint for keystore inside VPC (no public egress) or route to privatelink; (c) postmortem to capture detection latency and update runbooks.

kevin: I'll draft the privatelink proposal and cost estimate (NATGW vs PrivateLink vs regional HSM proxy). Initial estimate: PrivateLink reduces NATGW egress by ~65% for bootstrap traffic and removes dynamic allowlist needs but has per-ENI cost.

sam: logging note — we must include the firewall rule id in audit logs so postmortem can correlate. Also add sampling of `keystore` request traces into the observability dashboard.

priya: agreed. I'll open the compliance ticket referencing the exception and expected remediation timeline.

mira: final status: mitigation applied, majority of nodes joined, continuing to monitor for next 2 hours. Creating incident entry and linking relevant runbook steps.

alex: thanks all — going to close the urgent incident once we confirm 2h of stable joins. Action items assigned: kevin(privatelink proposal), mira(postmortem + incident doc), sam(reverse-exception after stabilization), priya(compliance ticket).
